// diagnostic E0936

Jet.UnknownTraitConstant

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

What

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

Why

An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares

Fix

Remove the constant, or declare `name: Type` in the trait

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnknownTraitConstant: Tests/UI/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.stderr.

Error: Jet.AmbiguousTraitConstant: The impl gives the constant `sites` twice
  --> Tests/UI/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:8:9
    |
  8 |         sites: [.Method],
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: An implementation has one value for each trait constant
 Fix: Remove one `sites: …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.AmbiguousTraitConstant

Error: Jet.UnknownTraitConstant: `accent` is not a constant of `Marker`
  --> Tests/UI/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:9:9
    |
  9 |         accent: .Red,
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares
 Fix: Remove `accent`, or declare `accent: Type` in `Marker`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UnknownTraitConstant

Error: Jet.TraitConstantTypeMismatch: The value of trait constant `repeatable` is not of type `Bool`
  --> Tests/UI/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:10:21
    |
 10 |         repeatable: 3,
    |                     ^
 Why: `Marker` declares `repeatable: Bool`, and each value has that type
 Fix: Write a value of type `Bool`
